name: Googlebot
description: Google's primary search-engine crawler. UA-pattern match plus IP cross-check against Google's published common-crawlers.json range file (refreshed by tools/refresh-bot-ranges.sh into /var/lib/botshield/bots/googlebot.txt).

name: bingbot
description: Microsoft's Bing search-engine crawler. UA-pattern match plus IP cross-check against Microsoft's published bingbot.json range file.

name: Applebot
description: Apple's search-engine crawler used by Siri Suggestions, Safari Smart Search, and Apple's Spotlight. UA-pattern match plus IP cross-check against Apple's published applebot.json range file.

name: GoogleOther
description: Google's research / experimental crawler family. Distinct UA token from Googlebot. Ranges published via special-crawlers.json (separate from Googlebot's common-crawlers.json).

name: Siteimprove.com
description: Siteimprove site-scanning crawler. UA matches the 'Siteimprove.com' substring inside the full UA shape 'Mozilla/5.0 ... SiteCheck-sitecrawl by Siteimprove.com; ...'. IP ranges scraped from Siteimprove's help-center article (no published JSON feed).
